title: Not What We Needed Today
summary: The day before Thanksgiving is often a dull one, with millions of Americans predominantly focused upon travel and pre-holiday planning. That is clearly not the case today, at least for market participants. FOMO, or “fear of missing out,” has morphed into plain old fear.
